rows.en: The UCE's long-planned operation to retake the <pic(0)><cs(3)>lunar cities<ce()> is now going ahead.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: Granada is the Moon's key stronghold; without it, an assault on the Giganos Lunar Empire
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: will be extremely difficult. We also need to weaken the Titans beforehand.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: We <mk(-75,-25,3,3)><ar(0,3,3,200)><mk(-62.5,-62.5,3,0,50)><ar(0,3,0,200)><mk(-25,-75,3,3,100)><ar(0,3,3,200)>will go in ahead, engage the defense forces, and cover our allies' push into Granada.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: The liberation of Granada should be a foothold for taking Giganos. Good work.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: On another matter, the UCE Parliament recently approved forming a UCE Space Force.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: The point is to unify, under UCE command, forces each UCE body has run on its own.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: It's supposedly for keeping order in space, but it is in effect an army made for war.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: Should the E2 never return, worst case, it's a fair call... but something bothers me.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: The UCE has changed since OZ took the lead... and the space colonies are pushing back.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: Things are unstable, but for now, all we can do is what is within our power.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: To think that even we of the Ra Cailum can't stand up to them...
rows.speaker: Bright Noa
